humidityNotes: Prefers average to high humidity; mist occasionally or use a pebble tray.
careTips: Thrives in bright, indirect light. Water when the top 2-3 cm of soil are dry. Wipe leaves to keep them dust-free. Rotate periodically for even growth.

humidityNotes: Tolerates dry air well; no extra humidity needed.
careTips: Extremely forgiving. Tolerates low light and neglect. Let the soil dry fully between waterings; root rot is the main risk. Feed once in spring.
Grows in almost any light condition. Water when the top soil is dry. Trims easily and roots in water for propagation.

humidityNotes: Enjoy extra humidity; group with other plants or run a humidifier nearby.
careTips: Loves bright, filtered light and stable conditions. Keep away from drafts and radiators. Water when the top 2 cm of soil are dry; feed monthly in growing season.

humidityNotes: Appreciates some humidity; brown tips often mean the air is too dry.
careTips: Easy-going and pet-safe. Bright, indirect light suits it best. Water when the top soil dries; flush the pot occasionally to clear fertilizer salts.

humidityNotes: Happy in dry air; stores water in its rhizomes.
careTips: Near-unkillable. Tolerates low light and long dry spells. Water sparingly - let the soil dry out fully between drinks.

humidityNotes: Loves humidity; mist regularly in winter.
careTips: Droopy leaves are a clear signal it is thirsty. Prefers shade to bright sun. Keep the soil lightly moist but never waterlogged.
A sunny windowsill is ideal. Water deeply but infrequently - let the soil dry completely between waterings. Use a gritty, fast-draining mix.
